title: Mesh Hop
summary: Full-screen MeshCore messenger for the deck: chats, contacts and radio settings on 640x480.
description: A full-screen client for MeshCore LoRa mesh networks. The deck controls a MeshCore companion radio board plugged into its USB port (the radio is on the board, the deck is the screen and keyboard). Two-pane Chats (channels and direct conversations with unread counts, a channel message ends at sent, a direct message at delivered), a Contacts table you can sort and filter by type and time since heard, and the radio Settings (node name, a list of the 26 firmware presets, bandwidth, spreading factor, coding rate and TX power chosen in a popup with arrows, direct message retries, board clock, board GPS switch, hashtag and private channels with a typed or random key, Yes / No confirmation before saving). Messages and contacts are kept between runs in ~/.local/share/mesh-hop. Text is typed with the Bluetooth keyboard only (there is no on-screen keyboard); touch is for taps, drag-scrolling and buttons, and Tab walks the tabs. Map and Terminal tabs are placeholders for later versions. The board must run the MeshCore companion radio firmware (USB); the user must be in the dialout group. Needs a launcher with full-screen app support (X-Fullscreen in .desktop files).
